arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: r_limit_max
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Red

arg.name: r_limit_min
arg.description: The minimum allowed field value Red

arg.name: g_limit_max
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Green

arg.name: g_limit_min
arg.description: The minimum allowed field value Green

arg.name: b_limit_max
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Blue

arg.name: b_limit_min
arg.description: The minimum allowed field value Blue
